text:
Residents:
Felix (30s) and Aisha (40s) work in town. Weekdays: out 08:00–17:30, home evenings. Weekends: sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day. Hobbies: Felix (knitting, movies, family calls); Aisha (running, houseplants, movies, family calls).

Object Locations & Routines:
Most items remain in their Tuesday 18:00 walkthrough locations. Key patterns observed:

Entry:
- Personal carry items (backpacks, jackets, keys, wallets, phones, headphones, scarves, shoes, water bottles, laptops, chargers, notebooks, pens, lunchboxes) are typically at the entry when residents are home.
- When residents leave for work (approx 08:00), these items disappear from the house (carried out).
- When residents return (approx 17:30-18:00), these items reappear at the entry.
- At 00:00, some items (phones, chargers) move to bedrooms (nightstand/desk) for the night.

Kitchen:
- Shared cooking items (cutting board, knife, spatula, pan) and dishes (bowls, mugs, glasses, plates) move to active use spots (sink, counter, table) in the evening (20:00) for meal prep/cleanup.
- By 00:00, these items are returned to storage (cupboards, drawers, dish rack).
- Water bottles are often in the dish rack or kitchen table in the evening, but move to the entry when residents leave/return.

Living:
- No significant changes. Felix’s knitting bag remains on couch.
- Board games move from bookshelf to coffee table at 00:00 (likely for late-night play) and return to bookshelf by 20:00.

Bathroom:
- Personal items (razors, skincare, towels) remain on shelves/racks.
- Aisha’s glasses move between nightstand and dresser in the early morning (00:00-08:00).
- Felix’s razor moved to sink at 08:00.
- Aisha’s skincare moved from shelf to medicine cabinet at 12:00 on Saturday.

Bedroom:
- Laptops, tablets, books remain on desk/nightstand.
- Phones and chargers are here at night (00:00) but move to entry when residents leave.
- Headphones move from desk to bed/nightstand in the afternoon (16:00) and return to desk by 20:00.
- Tablets move between bed, nightstand, and coffee table during the day.

Balcony:
- Gardening tools remain on floor/table. Gloves moved to table at 08:00.

Office:
- Empty.

General Notes:
- "Not seen before" items at 00:00 (phones) were likely in pockets/bags during the day and placed on surfaces at night.
- Shared kitchen items tend to move to the table/sink/counter in the evening for use, then return to cupboards/drawers by midnight.
- Personal items (keys, wallets, bags, phones) are typically at the entry when residents are home, and are carried out of the house when they leave for work.
- Phones are frequently moved to the coffee table in the living room during the day (12:00-16:00) before being taken out or put away at night.
